scope: Final Section 4.3.0 historical split/provider rules and Section 4.3.1 candidate construction; not a final fitted-model or event-study preregistration

retrospective_evaluation.defensible_use: Descriptive temporal replication and prespecified sensitivity with explicit adaptive/exploratory label
retrospective_evaluation.disallowed_claim: Untouched, independent final test or selection-adjusted confirmatory significance

exclusions.reason: Two-session legacy stub; excluded without inspecting outcomes
Outside frozen SPY panel; not certified unexposed and not silently promoted to a replacement holdout

confirmatory_test.rule: A separate timestamped full-model/analysis lock and independent exposure audit must precede any new confirmatory period. Do not claim the current construction freeze locks an unbuilt detector.

provider_eras.LEGACY: PiTrading through 2022-03-04; inherited adjustment/cleaning; historical clock and possible centered cleaning remain unresolved
provider_eras.RAW: IEX-labelled audited RAW starts 2022-03-07; no further dividend scaling
provider_eras.boundary: No bridging return, rolling feature, volume history, scaler, HMM fit, or state recursion across provider eras; report eras separately
provider_eras.volume: Raw/log volume diagnostic candidates only; use same-provider same-slot relative volume for scale-comparable candidates; never pool raw volume across providers
provider_eras.causal_claim: Past-only implementation does not repair or certify upstream vendor noncausality

clocks.calendar: Inherited frozen XNYS RTH grid, New York DST and early closes
clocks.bar_label: Minute-start assumption inherited from Section 3; full bar available at stamp + 60 seconds
clocks.legacy_sensitivity: Later cross-asset timing must report legacy -1/0/+1 minute scenarios; primary clock remains conditional
clocks.overnight: No overnight returns; first-minute return absent every session
clocks.missing: No interpolation/fill; NaN is never zero; exact adjacent endpoints for 1m return
clocks.target_rule: No TLT/HYG/GOLD/DOLLAR return columns in Section 4.3.1; same-minute target reaction is descriptive

nested_development.rule: Within each fold select using inner train/validation only; refit on preceding 252 sessions before outer development diagnostics. All features/scalers/models train chronologically; no selection on retrospective 2025-2026 or target reactions.
nested_development.feature_history: Causal same-era volume history may carry from previous observed sessions; fold fit statistics use training rows only; no numeric history from the excluded 2002 stub
nested_development.label: Development folds are not a newly restored clean final test

definitions.return_1m: ln(C_t/C_(t-1)); exact consecutive within-session closes, decimals
definitions.strict: For W in 5,10,15,30,60: require W eligible returns ending at t, slot>=W. RV=sqrt(sum(r^2)); downside=sqrt(sum(min(r,0)^2)); strict momentum=sum(r)
definitions.endpoint_momentum: ln(C_t/C_(t-W)) for W in 5,10,15,30,60; exact two closes and same session. Interior gaps allowed; not an RV estimator
definitions.partial90: sqrt(W/n * sum(observed r^2)) with full W-minute clock window and n>=ceil(.90 W). All five W; downside variant at W=15. Proxy, no assertion of random gaps or unbiasedness
definitions.sampled5: rv60_sampled5_exact: sqrt(sum of twelve exact five-minute log returns squared), closes at t,t-5,...,t-60. Sliding phase; a different sampling-scale estimator
definitions.volume: Raw and natural-log volume; log undefined for zero. relative_volume20=current volume/median positive same-slot volume from previous 20 scheduled sessions, at least 10 positives. Current zero ratio=0; log ratio unavailable
definitions.shock: (r_t-median(previous 60 exact returns))/(1.4826*MAD(previous 60)); require 61 consecutive eligible returns including current and positive MAD. No epsilon/fill for zero scale

selection_guardrails: No feature winner or model frequency selected by construction/coverage
For later HMM candidate comparisons, common training support, train-only scalers, identical target timestamps, forward-filtered states, and paired F0 baseline within each tier
Do not compare scores across tiers with different supports as if paired
No full-era quantile thresholds, fitted normalizers or HMM in 4.3.1
No nominal confirmatory p-values from exposed retrospective evaluation
verification: Independent formulas; missing-price and partial counts; session/halfday reset; prior-only volume; future edits/deletion; zero scales
Actual development masks, adjacent-close recomputation, no infinities, prefix deletion, source before/after SHA-256
amendments: Never edit this frozen file. A new timestamp/hash plus a change log is required; prior exposure remains documented.
